scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf .test-dist coverage && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
